thread:
Maya (Finance): Quick heads-up — pricing experiment (A/B rate buckets) is moving to wave 2 tomorrow. Need signoff on how we shepherd grandfathering exceptions into invoices.
Ben F.: docs? link?
Maya (Finance): https://drive.redwood/pricing/wave2-runbook — see the "exceptions" section. TL;DR: some legacy accounts have reserved tiers + active experiment cohort. We need a consistent charge logic.
Liam (Billing): main risk is double-billing when we backfill credits for cohort B but have reserved commitments recorded already.
Ashley - Product: Are we doing auto-grandfathering for customers who converted during the test window?
Maya (Finance): Proposal: keep legacy rate for the billing period if they were on it at the start of billing day. If they switched mid-period, apply pro-rated credit. See sample CSV I pasted earlier.
Carlos Ops: What's the signal? cohort flag + reserved_commitment > 0? If so we can tag invoice lines with `experiment_holdback=true` to make recon easier.
billing-bot: Deploy scheduled: invoice-service v3.7 at 03:00 UTC. Window: 30m. :gear:
Ben F.: Any vendor rate sheet mismatches? We have a vendor-proc rate change on the same day.
Maya (Finance): Good catch — vendor sent updated sheet yesterday. If vendor rates change, we should not pass through until after canary. Need a vendor gating step.
Zoe (Legal): For grandfathering exceptions, we need a short written approver trail. Can ops attach approver email to the invoice comment field? That satisfies audit.
Carlos Ops: We can add `invoice_notes.approval` with approver email and ticket ID.
Ashley - Product: For A/B analysis, we need clear flags so Optimize can correlate cost vs quality. Please add `experiment.bucket` and `experiment.variant` to the invoice payload.
Liam (Billing): For reconciliation: create a daily CSV of `invoice_id, account_id, applied_rate, legacy_rate, credit_amount, metadata.*` — ops can drop to S3. I can point QuickRecon to it.
Maya (Finance): OK plan: 1) Ops add tags to invoice payload; 2) Billing emits daily CSV; 3) Finance runs backfill script to apply pro-rated credits for mid-period conversions; 4) Legal stores approval references.
Ben F.: Who owns the backfill script and rollback plan?
Liam (Billing): Billing owns script, will support rollback by restoring snapshots. I'll add it to the runbook.
Maya (Finance): timeline: script ready by 02:00 UTC tomorrow, dry-run on shadow invoices today. Can ops run shadow with 10% sample?
Carlos Ops: I'll queue a 10% shadow run at 22:00 PT. Will post logs here.
billing-bot: Shadow run complete — 10% sample processed, 0 mismatches detected in sample. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Finance): Perfect. If we see mismatches in canary, we abort and revert. Otherwise we proceed to wave 2.
Zoe (Legal): Approved on exceptions process. Please cc legal on approval notes.
Ashley - Product: Noted. Product signoff: ready.
Ben F.: finance approves pending final vendor gating decision. 
Maya (Finance): Thanks team — I'll update runbook and ping again if anything changes. :pray:
